ops.body: Two more shapes from the third finder pass on PR #54, both observed with cc-transcript 14.40.0. (1) A redirect on an enclosing group: `(command -v printf) >"$(printf /dev/null)"` and the brace-group form run the substitution in all four shells; `with_redirects` copies the group redirect onto each inner command and no nested command is listed for its target. (2) The heredoc case is confirmed, not only likely: `CommandLine.parse("command -v x <<EOF\n$(pkill -f x)\nEOF").occurrences` holds the host alone. A heredoc on an enclosing group, `(true) <<EOF` with a substitution in the body, leaves no trace on the inner command at all, because `build_redirects` drops heredoc nodes.
